description:
Presidential Secretariat - Appointed the Lawyer Members and Valuer Members of the Board of Review for the period of three years with effect from 
02, 02, 2024
categorisation: This gazette announces appointments to the Board of Review (Lawyer Members and Valuer Members) and designates a Chairman and Vice Chairman. These are judicial/law enforcement appointments made under the Land Acquisition Act for the purpose of hearing appeals, fitting Type 9 (Judicial/Law Enforcement Gazettes) which covers court appointments, judicial matters, and appointments of officials for legal proceedings. While it involves the President making appointments, the content focuses on the judicial/administrative board structure rather than detailed ministerial portfolios or general government restructuring.
